title: First jazz band with Paul Villar and Edgar Briscoe
summary: He recalls the first band he organized with Paul Villar and guitar-banjo player Edgar Briscoe.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: I started playing Bohem system. How did you like the Bohem system? Oh, I never forgot about the first music I had was when I had made up a band. Me and Paul Villar, half of them guys half dead. Was that a dance band or a brass band? A jazz band. A jazz band. Jazz band, yeah. Paul Villar, Edgar, Edgar Briscoe. Edgar Briscoe used to play guitar, huh? Who?
Yeah, he used to play guitar banjo.

You remember him? Yeah, he told me that I didn't believe. Yeah, Edgar Briscoe. Yeah. He did the brickwork at my house. The house I built on down the night where he did the brickwork. But I used to play it.
Yeah, he used to play banjo. He used to play banjo.
